ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites: IE 340 credit is recommended. The purpose of this course is to understand models and theories of job and organization job, to be able to answer the questions “What makes for a good job?” and “What makes for a bad job?” Students will be able to apply models and theories of job and organization design to the analysis and redesign of jobs – to figure out how to improve a “bad” job, and ideally make it a good one. Finally, we will talk about processes to use to implement job redesigns.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
